title: Resolve DAO signer from bounded canonical pin snapshot on IID miss
description: dao_origin_signature vectors require a cryptographically identifiable pinned signer with a forged/noncanonical claimed source to be rejected as IidMismatch, while a genuinely unpinned signer remains UnknownKey. Keep exact indexed IID lookup first; on miss only, take a capacity-checked canonical snapshot of the bounded pin store, verify the DAO origin transcript against all candidates, accept exactly one signer, and fail closed on zero/multiple matches, capacity overflow, or corrupt key/IID entries. Preserve route/replay non-mutation assertions.
notes: Rust complete: exact claimed-IID pin lookup validates canonical key/IID; miss uses capacity-checked exhaustive canonical pin snapshot, verifies DAO transcript across all candidates, accepts exactly one and fails closed on zero/collision/corruption/overflow. DAO vectors return IidMismatch for source mutation and UnknownKey for unpinned signer; full node suite passes.
